subject: Isolation evidence workflow and annotated topology request
messages:
From: Jordan Silva <seceng@acmecommerce.com>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.example.com
Cc: Audit Team <audits@acmecommerce.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Request: isolation topology + evidence for upcoming SOC2 review

Hi Avery,

We're starting a scoped SOC 2 readiness exercise for our inference surface and need a compact evidence bundle from Redwood for the Private/Dedicated deployment option we're evaluating. Specifically we need:

- A single-page annotated network topology (minimum: control plane vs data plane demarcation, egress points, management interfaces).
- A short narrative describing tenant isolation controls (how KV cache/cache sharing, network segmentation, and KMS boundaries are enforced).
- A checklist/index of artifact names you will provide (diagrams, config snippets, ACL captures, attestations).
- Timeline: when we can expect the bundle (we have an auditor kickoff 2027-06-23).

Can you confirm scope and an estimated delivery window? If helpful, I'm happy to jump on a 30-min call tomorrow.

Thanks,
Jordan Silva
Security Engineering
Acme Commerce

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.example.com>
To: Jordan Silva <seceng@acmecommerce.com>
Cc: Audit Team <audits@acmecommerce.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.example.com, ben_carter@redwood.example.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: isolation topology + evidence for upcoming SOC2 review

Jordan — thanks for the clear ask. We can deliver a compact evidence packet that fits your auditor's timeline. Plan below: 

1) Deliverables (expected 2027-06-16 EOD)
   - Annotated topology (PDF, single page): control plane / data plane separation, tenant routing overlays, egress proxies, and management endpoints.
   - Segmentation matrix (CSV): which services live in which zones, ACLs, and logical trust boundaries.
   - Evidence index (Markdown): list of artifacts and short descriptions, plus links to the Drive folder.

2) What we'll not include right away: raw logs or customer keys (will supply redacted config and ACLs). If you need raw captures we can scope that separately.

3) Internal owners: Kimberly will validate the KMS/crypto boundary wording; Ben will include a sentence about Dedicated capacity SLAs and how fallback to hosted is prevented. I'll package the PDF topology.

If that works I will send the Drive link and attachments EOD tomorrow. If auditor needs it earlier, we can fast-track a minimal packet this afternoon.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Head of Solutions - Dedicated
Redwood Inference

Thanks — attached is the final packet we handed to Acme. Summary: topology annotated to show the Private control plane (customer VPC peering to the Redwood private control endpoint), data plane inference pods in an isolated tenant vnet, explicit egress proxies, and an HSM/KMS boundary callout. The segmentation_matrix_v2.csv now includes column "artifact_link" for quick evidence mapping. The evidence_index_20270616.md contains redaction notes.

Jordan — delivering the Drive folder link and a signed attestation sentence below: 

"Redwood Inference attests that for Dedicated and Private deployments we enforce cryptographic key separation such that customer keys and master KMS material are not shared across tenant boundaries; KMS operations are scoped to the tenant control plane and hardened by HSM-backed KMS providers. Access to key material is controlled via RBAC and logged for audit"

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cACME-evidence
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/ACME-2027-0192

Jordan, please confirm you've got everything you need for the auditor kickoff on 2027-06-23. If they want packetized raw captures we should open a separate request and agree on transfer method (SFTP with temporary creds).

Kimberly Park
Director, Security Assurance
Redwood Inference
